_about: Each of the 13 gauges in Processed_Final_data.csv mapped to a station in the UHSLC Fast Delivery dataset (ERDDAP global_hourly_fast). The BoM monthly files only name the country, and the dataset's coordinates are country-level approximations, so matching is by country plus the known monitoring site, not by distance. 'basis' says how each match was made. Gauge coordinates below are UHSLC's and are also used for the Open-Meteo forecast query. A UHSLC station can be a co-located instrument rather than the BoM SEAFRAME gauge itself.
